title: Final Answer (a)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the differential scattering cross section for high energy scattering.

title: Final Answer (b)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the differential scattering cross section for low energy scattering.

title: Use of Born Approximation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the Born approximation in part (a) to derive the scattering amplitude.

title: Wave Function Continuity
description: Important Criteria: The student must demonstrate the continuity of the radial wave function at the boundary r = a in part (b).

title: Limit Behavior Analysis
description: Optional Criteria: The student should analyze the limit as energy approaches zero and its effect on the scattering parameters.

title: Algebraic Manipulation
description: Optional Criteria: The student should show clear and correct algebraic manipulation leading to the final expressions.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect application of the delta function.

title: Units Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
